r2_vectors.title: mixed target days, do not silently filter

supplemental_graph_vectors.title: exact duplicate replay is idempotent
normative_basis: byte-equivalent wrapper replay is informational, not a new revision

supplemental_graph_vectors.title: claimed revision ID mismatch is validation error
normative_basis: revision_id is recomputed from versioned identity material; caller claim is never trusted

supplemental_graph_vectors.title: same immutable source pointer with different content digest is conflict
normative_basis: repo+commit+path identifies one immutable source slot; multiple normalized digests for it are contradictory evidence, not ordinary revisions

supplemental_graph_vectors.title: supersedes target must exist in same ledger input
normative_basis: supersedes is an explicit graph edge and cannot point to an absent revision

supplemental_graph_vectors.title: supersedes graph cycle is invalid
normative_basis: correction lineage must be acyclic; timestamp/order cannot break a cycle

supplemental_graph_vectors.title: two unrelated terminal revisions stay ambiguous even if arrival order differs
normative_basis: latest timestamp/input order/Git ancestry does not invent correction semantics

supplemental_graph_vectors.title: valid correction chain retains both revisions and projects explicit terminal
normative_basis: authoritative offline ledger retains immutable revisions; compatibility projection may select only the explicit terminal

supplemental_graph_vectors.title: fixture requesting publish authority is structurally rejected
normative_basis: fixture_only is const true; publication_admitted/action_eligible are const false

supplemental_graph_vectors.title: claimed wrapper identity mismatch is validation error
normative_basis: wrapper_id is recomputed from revision_id + explicit supersedes; caller claim is never trusted

supplemental_graph_vectors.title: same revision cannot arrive with two different wrapper relations
normative_basis: revision identity is content/provenance identity; one revision cannot have two contradictory semantic-edge wrappers

supplemental_graph_vectors.title: single quarantined terminal never becomes resolved projection
normative_basis: quarantine is not a structural validation failure but cannot become a resolved projection

supplemental_graph_vectors.title: self supersedes is invalid
normative_basis: a semantic correction edge cannot self-reference
